scripts.dev: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:local: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.local.jsonc && wrangler dev -c wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --env-file /dev/null && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun test/memory.test.ts && bun test/dream.test.ts && bun test/fts.test.ts
